basis: FD3 v1 did not correctly audit lane-stable UP events and its one-frame blank was shorter than the fixed 10-ms key-down duration.

engineering_assumptions.input_capacity: At most 14 current head positions and two current hold tails (FD-1 maxima).
engineering_assumptions.nearest_head: Choose maximum normalized screen position from current frame only.
engineering_assumptions.tie_rule: Exact rendered-position ties share one timing event, fanned out to their distinct current lanes.
engineering_assumptions.head_kind: Current rendered head shape labels tap versus hold; no note ID or schedule is exposed.
engineering_assumptions.hold_state: Track at most two held lanes; suppress tap UP for a held lane; emit UP only when that lane's visible tail reaches position 0.
engineering_assumptions.readout_rearm: Require 11 consecutive 1-ms blank frames after cue end: the fixed 10-ms key hold plus one frame for release/rearm before the next cue.
engineering_assumptions.key_pairing: Every UP is routed to the lane set retained from its matching DOWN, independent of the current cue lane.

timing_input: Frozen FD2-A8 monotone TTC transform; 50-ms window; fixed 500-ms horizon.
pass: Capacity/selection exact and deterministic; first and second full cues each issue a matching lane DOWN/UP; a partial cue may be silent but cannot issue another lane; chord issues both tied lanes and no others; every UP matches its original DOWN; two hold states release independently; MBON voltage finite and below threshold; weights unchanged; exact repeats.
